# slr_dogsay (Resource)

Renders text as ASCII art of a dog saying it (like cowsay) using [dogsay](https://github.com/sikalabs/dogsay).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "slr_dogsay" "example" {
  text = "Woof Woof! I'm a Dela!"
}

output "output" {
  value = slr_dogsay.example.output
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `text` (String) Text the dog should say.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the resource.
- `output` (String) Rendered ASCII art output.
